at work: My father is still at work, so he will come home late tonight.
我爸爸还在上班,所以他今晚回家会很晚。
put away: Please put away your toys before you go to bed.
上床睡觉前请把你的玩具收好。
sweep away: The wind swept away the leaves in front of our house.
风吹走了我们房前的树叶。
programme (AmE program): My favourite television programme starts at eight every Friday evening.
我最喜欢的电视节目每周五晚上八点开始。
Merry Christmas: He wished all his friends a Merry Christmas before the holiday began.
假期开始前,他祝所有的朋友圣诞快乐。
have a try: This cake looks delicious, so I want to have a try.
这蛋糕看起来很好吃,所以我想尝一尝。
sweet tooth: My sister has a sweet tooth and eats chocolate every day.
我妹妹爱吃甜食,每天都吃巧克力。
be proud of …: Her parents are proud of her because she won the speech contest.
她的父母为她感到骄傲,因为她赢得了演讲比赛。
sb. can't wait: The children can't wait to open their presents on Christmas morning.
孩子们等不及要在圣诞节早上打开礼物。
at school: I left my English book at school, so I must fetch it tomorrow.
我把英语书落在学校了,所以明天必须去取。
first prize: She won the first prize in the writing competition last month.
上个月她在写作比赛中获得了一等奖。
write about: The teacher asked us to write about our favourite childhood memory.
老师让我们写一写自己童年最喜欢的回忆。
count down: We all counted down from ten before the new year began.
新年开始前,我们一起从十倒数。
space travel: Space travel has become safer thanks to modern technology.
得益于现代技术,航天旅行变得更安全了。
solar system: The earth is the third planet from the sun in the solar system.
在太阳系中,地球是离太阳第三近的行星。
stomach ache: He ate too much ice cream and got a stomach ache.
他吃了太多冰淇淋,结果胃痛了。
catch a cold: Wear a warm coat, or you may catch a cold outside.
穿上暖和的外套,不然你在外面可能会感冒。
take sb.'s temperature: The doctor took my temperature and said I had a fever.
医生给我量了体温,说我发烧了。
fast food: Eating too much fast food is bad for your health.
吃太多快餐对身体不好。
take part (in sth.): More than two hundred students took part in the sports meeting.
两百多名学生参加了运动会。
in excellent condition: After exercising for months, my grandfather is in excellent condition.
锻炼了几个月后,我爷爷健康状况很好。
feel awful: I feel awful today, so I will stay at home and rest.
我今天感到不舒服,所以打算待在家里休息。
all over: After the long run, his body was aching all over.
长跑之后,他浑身都在痛。
I couldn't help laughing when I saw the monkey's funny face.
看到猴子滑稽的表情,我忍不住笑了。
The young singer won the heart of the audience with her beautiful voice.
这位年轻歌手用她动听的嗓音赢得了观众的心。
tidy up: We must tidy up the classroom before the guests arrive.
客人到来之前,我们必须把教室收拾整洁。
come out: Her first novel came out last year and sold very well.
她的第一部小说去年出版,销量很好。
as a result: It rained heavily all day; as a result, the match was cancelled.
大雨下了一整天,因此比赛被取消了。
make a list: Make a list of the things you need before you go shopping.
去购物之前,把你需要的东西列一个清单。
at the end of: There is a bookshop at the end of this street.
这条街的尽头有一家书店。
at the same time: The two runners crossed the finish line at the same time.
两名运动员同时越过了终点线。
daily life: Computers play an important part in our daily life.
计算机在我们的日常生活中起着重要作用。
stay in touch (with sb.): Though they live far apart, the two friends still stay in touch.
虽然两人住得很远,但他们仍然保持联系。
fill out: Please fill out this form and hand it in before Friday.
请填写这张表格,并在星期五之前交上来。
point out: The teacher pointed out several mistakes in my composition.
老师指出了我作文里的几处错误。
at the top of: You can see the whole city at the top of the hill.
在山顶上你可以看到整座城市。
wake sb. up: Please wake me up at six tomorrow morning; I have a train to catch.
请明天早上六点叫醒我,我要赶火车。
join in: Nobody wants to join in the game because it is too difficult.
没有人想加入这个游戏,因为它太难了。
day by day: With the teacher's help, his English is getting better day by day.
在老师的帮助下,他的英语一天天好起来。
show sb. around: The guide showed the visitors around the famous museum.
导游带领游客们参观了那座著名的博物馆。
